verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API reference documents API versioning: a version is selected with the 'x-api-version' request header, and endpoints carry a /v2/ path segment. The evidence contains nothing on a deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods, or a version-retirement schedule, so only half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a version changelog or support windows, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To take advantage of an API version, 'x-api-version' must be specified in API call request headers.
